Subject: Security questionnaire: data locality & retention (Hosted API)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for taking this. Attached is Sable's security questionnaire (sections 3 & 4 focus on data residency, retention, and deletion). We have a few items we'd like clarified for our security review:

1) Do you offer region-specific hosting for the Hosted API (US/EU/APAC)? Which sub-regions are supported?
2) What is the default retention for request/response payloads, embeddings, and logs?
3) How are cached artifacts (prefix cache, KV cache) handled and how quickly are they evicted?
4) What is the process and SLA for customer-initiated data deletion/erasures (including embeddings and any persisted cache)?
5) Do you ever use customer data to retrain models or otherwise persist it for training?
6) What evidence/artifacts can you provide to demonstrate deletion (audit logs, attestation)?

Please see the attached PDF for the formal questionnaire; a succinct response is fine. Our procurement timeline is looking at a security sign-off by 11/10.

Appreciate it —
Aisha Miller
Head of Security Operations
Sable Financial
security@sable.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Security questionnaire: data locality & retention (Hosted API)

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the questionnaire and the clear timeline. Below are Redwood's concise answers for the Hosted API items you flagged. I've attached a PDF export of these responses for your audit packet and linked a shared folder where our evidence artifacts will be staged. If you'd like us to complete the questionnaire directly inside your template, we can return a filled copy.

SUMMARY: Redwood does not use customer request/response content to train models. Our Hosted API supports region pinning (US / EU / APAC) on request for customers with regulatory constraints; by default accounts are provisioned in the US. Short answers follow; expanded notes are in the attached PDF.

1) Region-specific hosting:
- Supported regions: us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1.
- Default: US (us-west-2). Customers may elect EU or APAC placement during onboarding or via a configuration change.

2) Default retention (Hosted API):
- Request/response payloads: 30 days by default for operational debugging and abuse detection; configurable shorter retention upon request and generally reducible to 0 days with a private/dedicated plan.
- Embeddings: Ephemeral by default (48 hours) unless persisted by customer or requested to be retained for a specific feature (e.g., semantic search). Persisted embeddings are stored for the customer-defined TTL (common: 90d) and are stored in the pinned region.
- Application logs & audit traces: 90 days for standard retention. Longer retention tiers available as an add-on.
- Backups / snapshots: Encrypted backups retained for up to 30 days; snapshots used for disaster recovery are scoped per-tenant and region.

3) Cached artifacts (prefix/KV cache):
- Prefix caching / KV used by runtime to speed repeated prefix generation is memory/ephemeral-NVMe backed and is not written to long-term durable storage.
- Eviction policy: LRU with a maximum lifetime of 24 hours; explicit eviction occurs on model restart or when the cache node is decommissioned.
- Persistent cache for Dedicated/Private customers is configurable and documented separately.

4) Customer-initiated deletion / erasure process & SLA: 
- Erasure request path: open a support ticket (support@redwood.com) or use the Console > Data Requests. We acknowledge requests within 24 hours.
- Hosted API SLA: standard deletion confirmation within 72 hours for request/response payloads and logs; embeddings and persisted artifacts: 7 calendar days to delete + audit confirmation.
- Evidence: deletion is recorded in our audit log (timestamped entry) and we can provide a deletion report (JSON lines export) and a signed attestation on request.

5) Training and model usage:
- We do NOT use customer request/response content to train or fine-tune public models. Optionally, customers can opt in to a dataset-sharing program (explicit and contractually bound) — this is not default.

6) Evidence and artifacts:
- We can provide: audit-log export (scoped to the tenant & date range), deletion report, and a signed letter of attestation. For enterprise customers we can also schedule a remote evidence review session.

A few operational notes:
- Data is encrypted at-rest and in-transit using AES-256 + TLS 1.3; keys are customer-accessible via KMS integrations for Dedicated/Private plans.
- Geo-fencing: for EU pinned accounts, backups and audit logs are stored in the EU region and are subject to EU data handling controls.

Next steps: I will stage the deletion attestation template and an example audit-export in the Drive folder (link below). If Sable needs shorter retention defaults for request/response (e.g., reduce to 0 days), we can propose a configuration change during onboarding and include it in the contract addendum.

Link to evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_example_shared_evidence
Attached: Redwood_HostedAPI_Residency_Retention_Answers_11-02-2026.pdf

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — that is very helpful. A couple of clarifying items:

• Embeddings: you note ephemeral by default (48 hours) but persisted if customer requests. For our use-case we will persist embeddings for 180 days. Please confirm the deletion SLA for persisted embeddings — will that be within 7 days as stated?

• KV / prefix caches: can you provide any machine-readable evidence that an eviction occurred (e.g., cache-flush audit entry) if we request a purge?

• Attestation: we'll need a signed deletion attestation (PDF) and an audit log export for the tenant covering 11/01–11/10 before procurement sign-off. Is that feasible?

Finally, can you add a short line in the attestation that Redwood does not use persistent customer embeddings for model training?

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Aisha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Miller <security@sable.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire: data locality & retention (Hosted API)

Aisha —

Confirming:
- Persisted embeddings deletion SLA: 7 calendar days to remove persisted embeddings and provide a deletion report. We will include the deletion timestamp and object IDs in the report.
- Cache eviction evidence: for ephemeral prefix/KV evictions we can surface a control-plane audit entry indicating a purge/eviction event for the cache node (machine id + timestamp). We will prepare an example export.
- Attestation & wording: we will provide a signed PDF attestation that includes the statement: "Redwood Inference does not use persistent customer embeddings or request/response content as training data for our models unless explicitly contracted and opted-in by the customer."

Jonas / Ben — can you help assemble the attestation and the tenant-scoped audit export (11/01–11/10)? We should place the artifacts in the shared Drive folder and mark them as read-only to Sable's security team.

I'll follow up once the documents are staged.

Thanks,
Marissa
